Transcribed verbatim from the identical header comment block that appears at
the top of both qrcodegen.c and qrcodegen.h in this directory. Upstream
(github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator) carries no repository-wide LICENSE
file -- each source file embeds this same notice instead -- so there is no
separate upstream file to copy; this file exists so the notice also has a
copy independent of the source files, matching the pattern in
server/backends/vendor/README.md. See server/vendor/README.md for pin/hash
details.
